title: Glacier National Park and Banff Jasper Trip Planner Bundle, Canadian Rockies Itinerary, Montana Alberta Road Trip, Day Hikes PDF
description:
Our two trip planning guides for the northern Rockies together, for hikers planning Glacier National Park in Montana and Banff and Jasper in Canada on one summer trip. Glacier sits right on the border, so many people do both. $16.99 instead of $19.98 bought separately.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
- Glacier National Park Trip Planning Guide (30 pages): when Going-to-the-Sun Road opens, entry and passes, the Logan Pass shuttle and parking rules, what to book and when, bear and mountain safety, 2, 3 and 5-day plans, 12 day hikes in miles and km, packing list, budget and day planner
- Banff and Jasper Trip Planning Guide (30 pages): park passes and crossing from the US, reaching Lake Louise and Moraine Lake by shuttle, the Icefields Parkway stop by stop, wildlife and mountain weather, 3, 5 and 7-day plans, 12 day hikes in miles and km, packing list, budget and day planner

WHAT YOU GET
- Both guides in US Letter, A4 and a mobile edition, one ZIP per format
- Printer-friendly low-ink versions of both guides
- Instant download. These are digital files; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
The same two guides sold on their own, no extra content; no maps or GPX files included. Before crossing the border, check the current entry and document rules on the official US and Canadian government sites. Park passes, shuttles, fees and closures change every year, so check nps.gov and parks.canada.ca for your dates. For personal use. Not affiliated with the National Park Service or Parks Canada.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
